fieldValues.title: An affirmed problem is grounded in an affirmed domain
fieldValues.decision_question: What must an affirmed problem satisfy before it counts?
fieldValues.context: Relayed from the owner's walk of 2026-10-11 after session srs-programme#100; awaiting ratification.
fieldValues.decision_statement: An affirmed problem is grounded in an affirmed domain.
fieldValues.rationale: Applies the standing preference Convention before enforcement: the check warns first and becomes an error only after the walk has finished. Severity is the application, recorded elsewhere.
fieldValues.revisit_when: When personas weight priority, or when the warnings stop appearing on the problems of the walked domains and the rule can be enforced.
